# Données Decathlon

```{r}
decathlon <- factoextra::decathlon2
```


```{r}
decathlon  |>  
  rownames_to_column(var="Athlete") |>  
  gt::gt() |> 
  gt::tab_caption("Données decathlon (factoextra::decathlon2)")
```

## Corrélations

```{r}
decathlon |> 
  select(-Competition, -Rank) |> 
  mutate(across(contains('0m'), \(x) 1/x)) |> 
  corrr::correlate(method="spearman") |> 
  arrange(desc(abs(Points))) |> 
  select(term, Points, X100m, Shot.put, Long.jump, Discus, X400m, X110m.hurdle, High.jump, Javeline, X1500m, Pole.vault) |> 
  gt::gt() |> 
  gt::fmt_number(decimals=2)
```



```{r}
decathlon |>  
  select(-Competition, -Rank) |> 
  mutate(across(contains('0m'), \(x) 1/x)) |> 
  corrr::correlate(method="spearman") |> 
  corrr::autoplot()
```

## Régressions linéaires

```{r}
form1 <- Points ~ X100m + Shot.put + Long.jump
lm_1 <- lm(form1, decathlon)
```

Quelles sont les classes de `form1` et `lm_1`? De quelles méthodes sont munies ces classes?
(`sloop::s3_methods_class("lm")`)

```{r}
form2 <- Points ~ Long.jump + Shot.put + High.jump
lm_2 <- lm(form2, decathlon)
```

```{r}
form0 <- Points ~ .
lm_0 <- lm(form0, select(decathlon, -Rank, -Competition))
```

```{r}
form4 <-  Points ~ X100m
lm_4 <- lm(form4, decathlon)
```


```{r}
form5 <- Points ~ Pole.vault
lm_5 <- lm(form5, decathlon)
```

### Comparaison de modèles 

```{r}
list(lm_0, lm_1, lm_2, lm_4, lm_5) |>  
  map(glance) |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  mutate(Formule=c(form0, form1, form2, form4, form5)) |> 
  relocate(Formule) |> 
  gt::gt() |> 
  gt::fmt_scientific(columns=c(r.squared, adj.r.squared, statistic, p.value, deviance)) 
```

### Diagnostics


```{r}
p_lm_1 <- autoplot(lm_1, data=decathlon) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
p_lm_1@plots[[1]] + geom_point(aes(color=Competition))
```

```{r}
p_lm_1@plots[[2]] + geom_point(aes(color=Competition))
```

```{r}
p_lm_1@plots[[3]] + geom_point(aes(color=Competition))
```

```{r}
p_lm_1@plots[[4]] + geom_point(aes(color=Competition))
```

```{r}
autoplot(lm_0, data=decathlon) +
  theme_minimal()
```



```{r}
#| eval: false
plot(lm_1)
```

### retour sur comparaison de modèles 

```{r}
anova(lm_0, lm_1)
```


# Données mixtes


```{r}
data(whiteside)  # De MASS
```


```{r}
whiteside |>  
  slice_sample(n=5, by=Insul) |> 
  gt::gt()
```


```{r}
form0 <- Gas ~ Temp
form1 <- Gas ~ Insul
form2 <- Gas ~ Temp * Insul 
form3 <- Gas ~ (Temp + I(Temp^2))*Insul
forms <- c(form0, form1, form2, form3)
```


```{r}
lms <- forms |>  purrr::map(\(f) lm(f, data=whiteside))
```


```{r}
lms |> 
  purrr::map(glance) |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  mutate(Formule=forms) |> 
  relocate(Formule) |>  
  gt::gt() |> 
  gt::fmt_scientific(where(is.numeric))
```



```{r}
p_lm_1 <- autoplot(lms[[1]], data=whiteside) + theme_minimal()

p_lm_1@plots[[1]] + geom_point(aes(color=Insul))
```


```{r}
p_lm_1@plots[[2]] + geom_point(aes(color=Insul))
```


```{r}
p_lm_1@plots[[3]] + geom_point(aes(color=Insul))
```


```{r}
p_lm_1@plots[[4]] + geom_point(aes(color=Insul))
```



# Anscombe quartet


```{r}
anscombe <- datasets::anscombe
# From base R
anscombe <- anscombe %>%
  pivot_longer(- starts_with('y'), names_to = 'group', values_to = 'X') %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with('y'), names_to = 'groupy', values_to = 'Y') %>%
  filter(stringr::str_sub(group, 2L)==stringr::str_sub(groupy, 2L)) %>%
  select(-groupy) %>%
  mutate(group=stringr::str_sub(group, 2L)) 
```



```{r}
anscombe_nested <- anscombe |>  
  nest(.by=group, .key='donnees') 
  
  
anscombe_nested <- anscombe_nested  |> 
  mutate(lm_ = map(donnees, \(df) lm(formula=Y ~ X, data=df)))
```


```{r}
anscombe_nested$lm_ |>  
  map(glance) |>  
  bind_rows() |> 
  gt::gt()
```
